description: Local Ollama models when Ollama runs on the CPU (on battery, or ASUS GPU Mode Eco). Same registry, one longer attempt; prefer local/qwen2.5-3b, since the R1 models think for minutes on a CPU.
doneMessage: Local Ollama models are on (CPU timings). Ask in the console at http://127.0.0.1:8730/ (section 2). An attempt stops at 280 s, under the console's own ~300 s wait.
